papers.title: Mechanism of heat treatment regulation on the formation of Ti-6Al-4V oxide film in additive manufacturing and its corrosion resistance: Synergistic effect of matrix structure and residual stress
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory for Ecological Metallurgy of Multimetallic Mineral (Ministry of Education), Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, China

corresponding_authors.name: Jianzhong Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory for Ecological Metallurgy of Multimetallic Mineral (Ministry of Education), Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注热处理对Ti-6Al-4V耐腐蚀性的影响，但未涉及疲劳或力学性能，因此与后处理对力学性能调控的方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate fatigue or mechanical performance (tensile, fatigue) of Ti-6Al-4V after post-processing; it solely focuses on corrosion resistance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V氧化膜形成及耐腐蚀性的调控机制。
summary_zh.method: 进行不同热处理，分析氧化膜结构和残余应力。
summary_zh.result: 热处理通过协同影响基体结构和残余应力改善耐腐蚀性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过腐蚀实验和微观表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanism by which heat treatment regulates oxide film formation on additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V and its effect on corrosion resistance.
summary_en.method: Different heat treatments were applied, and oxide film structure and residual stress were analyzed.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment improved corrosion resistance through synergistic effects on matrix structure and residual stress.
summary_en.validation: Corrosion tests and microstructural characterization validated the findings.
